notes.content:
Items now have more information when hovering over the item.

The character tab also has more options for information on all items used.

When creating items +1 to +5 there is a chance of losing the item or failing production.

notes.title: Updat
notes.content:
(The game will be Online DAY: February 11, 2022)

[url=https://discord.gg/YmSBtcbRsZ]Discord Ulna Online[/url] . [url=https://www.facebook.com/Ulnaonlina]Facebook Ulna Online[/url]

Drop item on death dropped from 20% to 6%.

Items +1 +2 and +3 item drop percentage on death is 3% to 5%, items +4 and +5 do not drop on death.

Lair event was added to the game.

VIP was added to the game.

Guild was added to the game.

The player no longer dies when going down the holes.

Armor is at the level requirement, and the weapon is at the stat requirement.

Max level is now 300.

Location of up to level 100+ added.
Lestat shop now sells small, medium and large mana and health potions.

notes.title: update
notes.content:
The game has had several modifications, the armor requirements are now for levels.

Shops are selling mana potion, maps, teleportation.

Has guild system, vip system, balanced classes, chance to drop items from inventory was 6%, now player death causes loss of experience.

The difficulty in collecting resources on the map has decreased a lot and many other modifications.
